description: Intent i011 (chardev-ioctl-divisor, snapshot s02) complete. FINDING: drivers/media/dvb-frontends/dib8000.c:2786-2793 in dib8000_get_symbol_duration() — divisor is the fixed-width u32 expression (c->bandwidth_hz / 1000) at line 2793 (quote: 'return (LUT_isdbt_symbol_duration[i] / (c->bandwidth_hz / 1000)) + 1;'). Untrusted source: c->bandwidth_hz is set verbatim from the DVB chardev ioctl path FE_SET_PROPERTY -> dtv_property_process_set (drivers/media/dvb-core/dvb_frontend.c:1922-1923 'case DTV_BANDWIDTH_HZ: c->bandwidth_hz = data;') with no core validation (dvb_frontend_check_parameters validates only frequency and symbol_rate, never bandwidth_hz). Violated invariant: the only screening is the raw 'bandwidth_hz == 0' check in dib8000_set_frontend (lines 3613-3616 coercing 0 to 6000000); nothing proves the derived divisor nonzero at division width, so bandwidth_hz in [1,999] right-shift truncates the scaled divisor to 0 — the exact structural analogue of the seed's '8 * speed' wrap (checks validate f's input, not f's output). Unsafe use: the division executes from dib8000_tune line 3085 (state->symbol_duration = dib8000_get_symbol_duration(state)) in the CT_DEMOD_START state reached via the .set_frontend op (dib8000.c:4429) from FE_SET_FRONTEND/DTV_TUNE, oopsing on wrapped-zero (DoS). Counterevidence checked: dib8000_set_bandwidth (line 3060 call) internally re-coerces bw==0 to 6000, showing the driver anticipated this truncation elsewhere; dib8000 is SYS_ISDBT-only so the symbol_rate core check does not apply; the legacy DVBv3 path maps only enumerated BANDWIDTH_* constants. Also examined and classified safe: mb86a16.c srate divisions (raw symbol_rate_min=1000000 check keeps srate>=1000), stv0367.c symbol_rate divisors (symbol_rate_min=870000 plus explicit ==0 guard at 2989-2993), ds3000.c (explicit range check), cxd2841er.c DIV_ROUND_UP(3000000, symbol_rate) (min 1000000), stv090x.c timeout /= (srate/1000) (min 1000000), horus3a.c (symbol_rate only numerator), tda10023.c BDRI/=sr (raw checked value), dvb_frontend.c step_size/max_drift (constant divisors). Limitations: no runtime reproducer compiled; sweep prioritized symbol_rate/bandwidth_hz divisors within DVB frontends, so iio/tty/HID/input/misc chardev ioctls and other DTV properties were not exhaustively audited.
